events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival 2026 — Workshops
events.description: Participate in over 15 different improv workshops covering skills like storytelling, musical improv, and character development, led by experienced improvisers as part of the Brisbane Improv Festival. Ideal for those looking to expand their creative performance skills.

events.title: Build with AI 4.0 2026 – GDG Brisbane
events.description: Join Google Developer Group Brisbane for a community-driven, hands-on AI build event, where developers and curious tech thinkers can learn and experiment with AI tools together. Expect collaborative learning and practical application.

events.title: Brisbane Open House — Talks, Walks & Workshops
events.description: As part of Brisbane Open House, this program offers guided walks on flood-resilient urban design, a conversation on GOMA's anniversary, a live bronze pour workshop at UAP Foundry, and special access tours to Cross River Rail construction.

events.title: Brisbane Makerspace Open Night
events.description: A regular open night to explore Brisbane Makerspace's facilities for 3D printing, laser cutting, and electronics, meet like-minded people, and learn about the maker community.

events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival 2026 — Nightly Shows
events.description: Experience five nights of diverse improvised shows from Brisbane's improv community, featuring formats from comedy and musical improv to horror and drama, performed by local and national artists. This festival offers a celebration of spontaneous theatre and storytelling.

events.title: Brisbane Open House 2026
events.description: Explore 93 significant buildings across Brisbane, including private homes, commercial towers, and cultural venues, with rare access, guided walks, talks, and concerts. This free event offers insight into Brisbane's architecture, design, and history.

events.title: A Conversation with Jefferson Fisher
events.description: Join lawyer and communicator Jefferson Fisher for an insightful conversation on human communication, confidence, and psychology. Known for his accessible insights, this event offers a chance to engage with complex topics.

events.title: ASPG-Q: AI in Parliament – Risks, Opportunities and What's Next?
events.description: A panel discussion exploring the impact of artificial intelligence on parliamentary governance, discussing both risks and opportunities. This event is ideal for those interested in AI, public policy, and the future of technology in government.

events.title: The Explainer Series: First Nations Astronomy
events.datetime: This week July 2026 (check listing for exact date/time)
events.description: An engaging talk delving into Indigenous astronomical knowledge systems, including sky stories and the scientific insights embedded in First Nations culture. Discover the deep connections between ancient wisdom and celestial observations.

events.title: House Blend: Jazz & Deep House Experience by Nouvelle Nights
events.description: An intimate and atmospheric jazz and deep house fusion event curated by Nouvelle Nights, designed to attract a creative and culturally curious audience. Expect a unique blend of musical styles in a sophisticated setting.

events.title: Brisbane Open House 2026 — Architecture Tours, Talks & Walks
events.description: An annual event opening 93 significant buildings across Brisbane, offering guided tours, public talks, hands-on workshops, and unique access to architectural and construction sites, fostering community engagement with design and history.

events.title: Steve Irwin Memorial Lecture: From Steve's Vision to Scientific Discovery

events.title: Integration in an AI World: Building for Humans, Systems, and Agents

events.title: The AI Attack Surface: Understanding the New Security Frontier

events.title: Essentials of Compelling Fiction with Isobelle Carmody (Workshop)

events.title: Plot and Structure with Melanie Myers (Workshop)

events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival 2026: On the Spot | Workshop

events.description: Led by Ben Russell, this workshop provides practical techniques for improvisers to get out of their heads, focusing on character development and relationships over plot, encouraging a slower, more patterned approach.

events.description: This workshop, presented by Lê Kim Thanh, offers playful methods to let clear ideas emerge through movement, thought, or emotion on stage, helping participants relax and discover powerful improv by doing less.

events.title: EmAGN Value Talk: Living Legacy of the Queensland Cultural Precinct
